That leaves the dark piece: the three bottom‑front cubes (visible as the dark row) plus the only remaining cube, the hidden bottom‑back‑left cube. So the dark shape is a straight line of three cubes with one cube attached at right angles to one end — an L‑shaped tetracube.

- A: skew (Z) shape — no.
- B: line of three with one at the end — yes, matches.
- C: 3D corner shape — no.
- D: T shape (extra cube at middle) — no.
- E: 3D bent shape — no.
